source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Login to BMC WebUI.
2. Set power restore policy - Always power off
3. Reboot BMC and make sure the setting is not change.
4. When SUT is power on/off, unplug AC power cord and replug the power cord. Check SUT power status.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Power Restore Policy should not change.
2. SUT power restore behavior should be correct as setting.
    - Alwats power off -> SUT should always remain off even after AC power back.

original_test_intent: Verify AlwaysOff persists through BMC reboot and causes the SUT to remain off after controlled AC restoration, for approved starting power states.
original_method: After explicit approval, record original policy and safe workload/PDU baseline, set/read back AlwaysOff, reboot BMC and verify persistence, have an operator perform a controlled AC cycle, observe the SUT remains off, then restore the approved final policy/state.
manual_activity: Owner approves enum, both intended starting states, maintenance/recovery and final policy. Human operator controls the exact PDU outlet and confirms physical state; agent may perform only separately approved protected policy actions and evidence collection.
required_inputs: Explicit staged approvals and reviewed Script
safety_requirements: Do not clear logs or hot-pull an active service.
Require exact target/outlet confirmation and human AC control.
Capture/read back the original policy before any write.
Stop on write/persistence/reachability/power/alarm anomaly and perform no automatic retry.
Restore/verify the approved final policy and safe PDU/SUT state.
agent_execution_scope: Static review validates the Project runbook/evidence contract only.
If separately authorized, capture baseline and set/read back exact AlwaysOff enum.
Verify persistence after approved BMC reboot.
Observe human-controlled AC removal/restoration and resulting off state for each approved pre-state.
Restore final policy/state and return evidence without verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve property/enum, starting-state matrix and final policy.
Approve outage, PDU, timeout and recovery plan.
Authorize each state-changing stage and issue formal verdict.

review_improvement: Preserves the real AC behavior checkpoint while preventing a Redfish read-back or ungoverned power pull from being treated as sufficient/safe.
independent_technical_reasoning: Power-restore policy has two independent checkpoints: persistent configuration across BMC reboot and physical chassis behavior after loss/restoration of AC. The latter cannot be simulated by read-back, and both starting-state wording and persistent side effects require an explicit state matrix, outage control and policy restoration.
